Hi Len,

Sorry for the wait on this, things have been very intense on our end and we should have gotten back to you sooner.

Could you let us know which code you were trying to use? Some of our codes apply only to specific product categories (seeds and seed bombs, for example), and a stray space in the field can also stop them from going through. If you share the code, we can apply the discount directly to your order and make sure you get it.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
